items.title: ‘Call his agent’: Emery feels Watkins should explain absence from Villa’s rout by Brighton
items.summary: England forward is considering move to Al-Hilal ‘This question is for him … I answer only with silence’ Unai Emery did nothing to deny that Ollie Watkins had refused to play for Aston Villa in their sobering 4-0 defeat by Brighton at the Amex on Sunday. The head coach had a selection crisis up front with Brian Madjo and Tammy Abraham injured. However, he did not include Watkins in the matchday squad as the England striker considers a move to Al-Hilal in Saudi Arabia. Emery was forced to rely on the attacking midfielder Emiliano Buendía as an emergency striker and his team disappeared without trace on the south coast. They were 4-0 down after 31 minutes and had their new signing João Gomes sent off on his debut in the 40th minute. Gomes kicked up and out at the Brighton striker Georginio Rutter after being dispossessed by him. Continue reading...

Marc Guéhi’s 85th-minute equaliser and Josko Gvardiol’s 91st-minute winner gave City’s new manager victory in his first game, after Marcus Tavernier’s first-half strike for the visitors. items.title: Manchester City agree deal worth up to €100m for Lille’s Ayyoub Bouaddi
items.summary: Signing will take City’s window spending to nearly £200m Moroccan stood down from Lille’s game against Angers Manchester City have agreed a deal with Lille worth €95m (£81.4m) plus €5m in potential add-ons for Ayyoub Bouaddi, with the Morocco midfielder’s arrival to take the club’s summer spend to nearly £200m after Elliot Anderson’s £116m signing earlier in the window. The 18-year-old was stood down from Lille’s Ligue 1 match against Angers on Sunday before a medical with City and his transfer becoming official in the next few days. Continue reading...

items.title: Une légende du football belge retrouve enfin le véritable Anderlecht : "Il ne faut plus les sous-estimer"

Le portier légendaire de notre équipe nationale est conquis par le début de saison des hommes de Vitor Bruno, ainsi que par le gardien du RSCA, Colin Coosemans. "Un très bon gardien, qui est aussi un vrai leader sur le terrain."
